spec.window: entries only 09:30-11:30 ET (930-1050 min after the 18:00 open)
spec.entry: first band touch inside the window, filled at the band level (or session open if gapped through)
spec.target: f * H in favour, H = (upper band - lower band)/2
spec.stop: g * H against; if target and stop occur inside the same minute, the stop is assumed first
spec.timeStop: any open position closed at the 11:30 bar close
spec.alignment: daily band rescaled per session by intradayOpen/dailyOpen (daily series is back-adjusted)

multipleTesting.note: with 72 cells, about 3.3 are expected to show |t|>2 by chance

ruin.note: no leverage means the account must be at least the $10,000 stake, so a 20% drawdown needs a run 10x the observed worst

kelly.rejectedBecause: the 95% CI on expectancy spans zero, so the numerator is not distinguishable from zero
